items.title: Genevieve Rose interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: I really enjoyed performing last October down in New York with Benny Waters, the saxophone player, at Sweet Basil’s jazz club in New York.

ctx.x: Is there a gig or a particular series of gigs — it’s almost the same question — but that you felt like man this is the big time in the jazz world? When did that particularly happen?

Well I really enjoyed performing last October down in New York with Benny Waters, the saxophone player, at Sweet Basil’s jazz club in New York. That was the first time I ever really publicly played in New York City and it was a week-long engagement. And I really enjoyed that. Really nice.
Well there you are at one of the top clubs in New York, with what he was 95 at the time?
